system_prompt_style.note: Agent prompts live on the discontinued server; the client repo holds no prompt code, and the paper defers agent instructions to the supplementary.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: The retrieval agent Ar then takes a sub- task Ti as input to call a tool to query the BlenderRAG database, which retrieves the relevant Blender documentation and summarizes it as Ri
env_context_strategy.note: The paper says RAGFlow is used. Embedding-based retrieval is inferred, not stated; the paper does not name the retrieval type.

context_compaction.note: Server code is not available. The paper describes shared full context but does not describe any compaction mechanism.

observation_format.evidence_quote: the critic agent calls a tool to pass the rendered images and a pre-defined prompt P into an external vision-language model (VLM)
observation_format.note: Rendered images feed the critic. Execution error text feeds back into the loop.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: This indicates the client received a Blender Python (bpy) script from the server. The script will now be executed in Blender.
tool_call_format.note: The agent tool-call API is inside AutoGen on the server and is not visible here.

tool_count.note: The tool registry lives on the server and is not in the evidence.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: The coding agent takes T′, updates the current Blender script, and executes it.
edit_primitive.note: The coding agent emits the complete script. Edit mechanics are not specified.

tool_schema_source.note: Tool schemas live on the server and are not in the evidence.

protocol_standardization.note: Only the client is released. The paper mentions MCP only for the BlenderMCP baseline.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Our approach consists of a three-phase process: initial creation, auto-refinement, and user-guided refinement
loop_primitives.note: The phases contain error-fix loops and critic-verify loops.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: The planner agent Ap takes as input T and decomposes it into n specific subtasks
planning_granularity.note: The paper says the subtask list is iterated. A stored plan object is inferred, not stated.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: The agents are orchestrated by an external controller that handles their communication and order.
multi_agent_topology.note: Six agents under an AutoGen controller. The topology also has pipeline aspects.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: This allows shared contexts between all agents, meaning that one agent can see the output of every other agent

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Provide instructions to refine the 3D object, or type `TERMINATE` to end the session.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: the conversation his- tory of the agents is shared across the 3D asset generation

long_term_memory.note: The server is not in the evidence. BlenderRAG is static documentation, not memory.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: This creates a **new session** based on your previous work
state_persistence.note: The CLI loads the prior final script into a new session; it does not resume the interrupted run.

self_verification.evidence_quote: we intro- duce a verification agent, also driven by a VLM.
self_verification.note: test_execution approximates the execution-error feedback loop. llm_judge covers the critic and verification VLMs.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: This process of error correction by the retrieval and cod- ing agents repeats until the code execution does not yield an error.
retry_policy.note: Scope here is subtask-level repair, not whole-task retry.

rollback.evidence_quote: this demo version of LL3M does not currently support reverting changes made during user-guided refinement.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: This cycle continues until the user explicitly provides a keyword to terminate the pro- cess.
termination_condition.note: Closest-value fit: termination is by a user keyword, plus a 3-minute inactivity timeout.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: We employ GPT- 4o [45] for the planner and retrieval agents
cost_controls.note: The per-role fixed model assignment is closest to model_routing. A service limit of 5 requests per day also applies.

timeouts.evidence_quote: [WARNING: Session will timeout after 3 minutes of inactivity]
timeouts.note: This is an inactivity timeout, not a wall-clock run cap.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: To get started, make sure both Blender and LL3M are running on the same machine.
execution_isolation.note: Server-generated bpy code runs in the local Blender process via the addon.
